messages:
Jordan (NorthernStar): Hey team — onboarding warmup failing in staging. We get intermittent 401s claiming missing auth header and occasional 429 spikes right when our CI fanout kicks off. Started after we switched to the mobile SDK.
Riya (CSM): thanks Jordan. Can you share SDK version, token issuer, and a tiny log snippet? Looping in @Max and @Hannah.
Jordan (NorthernStar): SDK mobile v0.9.7, tokens from our vault-service (short-lived). Log: `POST /v1/embeddings 401 {id:\"req_zz12\", error:\"unauthorized\", hint:\"missing auth header\"}`. Note: curl from same runner succeeds. We run 40 parallel warmup workers.
Max (SDK): two common causes: 1) header lost by intermediate (edge worker/fanout) 2) very tight TTL + clock skew and queueing. Also older mobile SDK had retry behavior that retried immediately on `Retry-After: 0`. Which fanout mechanism?
Jordan (NorthernStar): we use a small edge Lambda that receives GH Actions and uses fetch() to call the SDK endpoint. Vault issues tokens with exp about 75s after iat.
Hannah (SRE): 75s is borderline for large parallel warmups. Also tracing shows some outbound calls from the lambda with empty `authorization` header. That points to header-whitelist/filtering on the fanout path.
Riya (CSM): quick remedials: add Authorization to the forward whitelist, add a small randomized start delay per worker (0-300ms), and increase token TTL or do per-worker refresh. I'll open an ops ticket for temporary rate increase.
Jordan (NorthernStar): added Authorization to forwarder and added a 0..200ms jitter. Also bumped vault TTL to 5m for onboarding. Re-ran 3 warmups: 401s disappeared, 429s dropped from ~20% to ~3%.
Max (SDK): thanks — follow-ups: in mobile SDK please set `respectRetryAfter:true` and lower maxAttempts during warmup. We'll push a docs blurb about token TTL, header forwarding, and jitter. I'll open SDK ticket SDK-510 and a docs PR.
OpsBot: Ops ticket OPS-4682 created: "NorthernStar temporary onboarding throttle" 12h watch assigned to infra-ops.
Hannah (SRE): note for posterity: if you must keep short TTLs, implement token exchange (one long-lived per runner -> short-lived per request) and ensure ntp sync on runners.
Riya (CSM): action items: 1) Jordan: keep jitter and TTL bump for onboarding (Jordan) 2) Max: docs + SDK ticket (Max) 3) Riya: monitor OPS-4682 and follow up. Closing if stable. :white_check_mark:
